fields.title: Welcome to Whole Life Journey
fields.summary: Get started with your personal life operating system for reflection, growth, and intentional living.
fields.content:
## What is Whole Life Journey?

Whole Life Journey is a **personal life operating system** that brings together the different dimensions of your life into one intelligent platform. Instead of using separate apps for journaling, health tracking, task management, and goals—WLJ connects everything so the AI can see the whole picture.

## Why This Matters

Most apps only see one part of your life. WLJ sees:
- **Your moods** from journaling
- **Your health patterns** from tracking
- **Your productivity** from tasks completed
- **Your spiritual journey** from faith tracking
- **Your intentions** from your stated goals

**The connection is the power.** When you journal about stress and the AI notices you also skipped workouts that week, it can make that connection for you.

## Getting Started

### 1. Check Your Dashboard Daily
Your Dashboard is home base. Even a 30-second glance keeps you connected to your goals and shows you what needs attention.

### 2. Start with One Module
Don't try to use everything at once. Pick what matters most:
- **Journaling** if you want self-awareness
- **Health** if you're focused on physical wellness
- **Faith** if you want to track your spiritual journey
- **Organize** if you need task/project management

### 3. Enable AI Features
In Preferences, enable AI for personalized insights. The more data you provide, the smarter it gets.

### 4. Set Your Goals
The Goals module anchors everything. When the AI knows your goals, it can prioritize better.

## Core Features

| Module | What You Log | What You Get |
|--------|--------------|-------------|
| **Dashboard** | Nothing—it aggregates | Daily insights, celebrations, nudges |
| **Journal** | Thoughts, moods | Emotional pattern analysis |
| **Health** | Weight, food, medicine, vitals | Health trend tracking |
| **Faith** | Prayers, scripture | Answered prayer history |
| **Organize** | Tasks, projects, events | Productivity patterns |
| **Goals** | Goals, direction | Drift detection, alignment |
| **Scan** | Photos of food, medicine | Instant data entry |

## Next Steps

1. **Customize Preferences** - Choose your theme, modules, and AI coaching style
2. **Write your first journal entry** - Build your streak
3. **Set your Goals** - Annual direction and life goals
4. **Enable SMS notifications** - For medicine and task reminders

fields.title: Understanding Your Dashboard
fields.summary: Your Dashboard is the intelligence center that transforms your daily data into actionable insights.
fields.content:
## Why Your Dashboard Matters

Your Dashboard isn't just a home page—it's where raw data becomes **actionable intelligence**. Every journal entry, health measurement, and completed task feeds into this view.

## How Your Data Becomes Insight

When you:
- **Journal consistently** → AI detects mood patterns
- **Track weight** → AI notices trends and plateaus
- **Complete tasks** → AI learns your productivity rhythms
- **Log medicine** → AI monitors adherence rates

**The result:** Personalized insights that generic apps can't provide.

## Dashboard Components

### Quick Stats (Clickable Tiles)
These tiles link directly to each module:
- 🔥 **Journal Streak** → Journal entries list
- ✓ **Tasks Today** → Task list
- 🙏 **Active Prayers** → Prayer list (if Faith enabled)
- 💊 **Medicine Doses** → Medicine tracker
- 💪 **Workouts This Week** → Workout list

### Today's Insight
An AI-generated observation personalized to:
- Your recent activity
- Your mood patterns
- Your coaching style preference

This isn't generic advice—it's based on YOUR data.

### Celebrations
Recognition of your achievements:
- Streak milestones
- Goal completions
- Consistency wins
- Health improvements

### Accountability Nudges
Gentle reminders about:
- Overdue tasks
- Missed medicine doses
- Goals you've neglected
- Habits that have slipped
- Refills needed

### Today's Priorities (if Assistant enabled)
AI-suggested priorities ordered by importance:
1. Faith items (if enabled)
2. Goals-aligned items
3. Urgent tasks
4. Maintenance items

## Tips for Dashboard Power Users

1. **Check it first thing** - Make it your browser home page
2. **Click the tiles** - Direct access to each area
3. **Enable the Personal Assistant** - For proactive priorities
4. **Log consistently** - More data = smarter insights

fields.title: Journaling for Self-Awareness
fields.summary: Your journal powers AI insights about your emotional patterns, life rhythms, and personal growth.
fields.content:
## Why Journal in WLJ?

Your journal isn't just a diary—it's the **primary data source** for AI insights. Every entry teaches the system about:

- **Emotional patterns** - What triggers stress? What brings joy?
- **Life rhythms** - Busy seasons, restful periods
- **Growth** - How far you've come
- **Values** - What you write about reveals what matters

## The Dashboard Connection

When you journal consistently:
- Your **Daily Insight** becomes more relevant
- The AI notices **mood trends** you might miss
- Your **Journal Streak** tile celebrates consistency
- The Personal Assistant suggests **reflection prompts**

## Creating an Entry

1. Click **"New Entry"** from the Journal page
2. Enter a title (or leave blank for auto-date)
3. Select your current **mood**
4. Write your thoughts
5. (Optional) Add **categories**
6. Click **"Save"**

## Mood Tracking

Selecting your mood enables:
- Mood trend charts over time
- AI insights about emotional triggers
- Pattern detection (e.g., "You feel anxious on Mondays")

## What Your Journal Teaches the AI

| What You Write | What the AI Learns |
|----------------|--------------------|
| Daily moods | Emotional patterns |
| Challenges | Recurring struggles |
| Wins and gratitude | What brings you joy |
| Goals mentioned | Progress tracking |
| Relationships | Who matters to you |

## Tips for Powerful Journaling

1. **Same time daily** - Consistency builds the habit
2. **Three sentences count** - Perfection isn't required
3. **Be honest** - AI learns from authentic entries
4. **Review monthly** - See your own growth
5. **Use prompts** - Personal Assistant suggests topics

fields.title: Health Tracking Overview
fields.summary: Track weight, nutrition, medicine, vitals, and fitness to understand your physical wellness patterns.
fields.content:
## Why Track Health in WLJ?

**What gets measured gets managed.** But more importantly, when health data connects to your other data (journal moods, stress patterns, goal progress), you get insights no standalone health app can provide.

## Health Sub-Modules

### Weight Tracking
**Why:** See long-term trends, not daily noise
- Set goal weight in Preferences
- AI notices plateaus and progress
- Dashboard shows progress toward goal

### Nutrition / Food Tracking
**Why:** Understand what you eat
- Log meals manually or via Camera Scan
- Track calories and macros
- See patterns in eating behavior

### Medicine Tracking
**Why:** Never miss a dose
- Set up medication schedules
- One-tap daily check-off
- SMS reminders with quick-reply
- Refill alerts before you run out

### Vitals (Blood Pressure & SpO2)
**Why:** Monitor between doctor visits
- Automatic health categorization
- See trends over time
- Bring data to appointments

### Fasting
**Why:** Track intermittent fasting
- Start/end fasting windows
- View history and streaks
- SMS reminders for eating windows

### Fitness / Workouts
**Why:** Build exercise consistency
- Log workouts with templates
- Track weekly counts
- Dashboard shows "Workouts This Week"

### Medical Providers
**Why:** Organized healthcare contacts
- Store doctor/clinic info
- Patient portal URLs
- AI-assisted provider lookup

## The Dashboard Connection

Your health data powers:
- Weight progress bar toward goal
- Nutrition summary with macros
- Medicine status for today
- Fitness count for the week
- AI nudges when you haven't logged

## Tips for Better Health Tracking

1. **Log at consistent times** - Same time daily
2. **Use Camera Scan** - For quick food logging
3. **Enable SMS reminders** - For medicine adherence
4. **Set realistic goals** - In Preferences
5. **Check weekly trends** - More important than daily

fields.title: Faith Module: Tracking Your Spiritual Journey
fields.summary: Track prayers, scripture, and milestones to see God's faithfulness over time.
fields.content:
## Why Track Faith?

Faith isn't just about the present moment—it's about **seeing God's faithfulness over time**. When you track prayers and mark them answered, you build a record of how God has moved in your life.

## The AI Connection

With Faith enabled:
- **Faith-first priorities** - The Personal Assistant prioritizes spiritual matters
- **Faith insights** - AI considers your spiritual journey in daily insights
- **Answered prayer celebrations** - Dashboard recognizes God's responses

## Faith Features

### Prayer Requests
**Why:** Never forget what you're praying for

1. Click **"New Prayer"**
2. Set priority (Normal or Urgent)
3. Mark **Answered** when God responds
4. View answered prayer history

**The power:** Months later, review answered prayers. You'll be amazed at patterns you forgot.

### Scripture
**Why:** Save verses that speak to you

- Search by reference
- Save with personal notes
- Organize by topic
- Review during difficult times

### Faith Milestones
**Why:** Mark spiritual turning points

- Salvation
- Baptism
- Answered prayers
- Spiritual insights
- Community moments

## Tips for Spiritual Growth

1. **Log prayers as you pray** - Don't wait
2. **Update status promptly** - Mark answered when it happens

4. **Connect to journal** - Reflect spiritually

The Faith module is optional. Enable or disable in Preferences. When disabled, faith-related content disappears from navigation and Dashboard.

fields.title: Customizing Your Preferences
fields.summary: Personalize themes, modules, AI coaching styles, goals, and notifications.
fields.content:
## Why Preferences Matter

WLJ adapts to YOU, not the other way around. Your Preferences control:
- What you see (module toggles)
- How it looks (themes, colors)
- How the AI talks (coaching style)
- Your goals (weight, nutrition targets)
- Your notifications (SMS categories)

## Key Settings

### Theme & Appearance
- **Theme** - Minimal, Faith, Sports, Nature, Outdoors
- **Accent Color** - Custom highlight color
- **Dark/Light Mode** - System or manual

### Module Toggles
Disable what you don't need:
- Journal
- Faith
- Health
- Organize
- Goals


Disabled modules disappear from navigation.

### AI Settings
- **Enable AI** - For intelligent insights
- **Coaching Style** - How AI communicates:
  - Supportive Partner (warm)
  - Direct Coach (brief)
  - Gentle Guide (patient)
  - Wise Mentor (thoughtful)
  - Cheerful Friend (upbeat)
  - Calm Companion (steady)
  - Accountability Partner (focused)

### Personal Assistant
- Enable for AI-powered daily priorities
- Requires separate consent (deeper data access)

### Weight & Nutrition Goals
- Target weight with deadline
- Daily calorie goal
- Macro split (Protein/Carbs/Fat)
- Presets: Balanced, High Protein, Low Carb, Keto

### SMS Notifications
- Verify phone number
- Enable/disable by category
- Set quiet hours

### Timezone
- Set for accurate streaks and dates

## Tips for Optimal Settings

1. **Start with fewer modules** - Add more later
2. **Try different coaching styles** - Find what resonates
3. **Set realistic goals** - Better to exceed than constantly miss
4. **Enable Personal Assistant** - Most powerful feature
5. **Use SMS reminders** - Harder to ignore than app badges

fields.title: AI Coaching Styles Explained
fields.summary: Choose how the AI communicates with you—from warm encouragement to direct accountability.
fields.content:
## Why Coaching Styles Matter

Different people respond to different communication styles. The AI coach adapts its tone based on your preference. This affects:
- Daily insights on your Dashboard
- Personal Assistant messages
- Reflection prompts
- Nudges and reminders

## Available Styles

### Supportive Partner
**Best for:** Those who thrive on encouragement

Warm and nurturing. Celebrates wins, provides gentle guidance during struggles. Uses affirming language.

### Direct Coach
**Best for:** Those who want efficiency

Brief and action-oriented. Gets straight to the point. No fluff, just clear instructions.

### Gentle Guide
**Best for:** Those who need patience

Calm and unhurried. Takes time to explain. Never rushes you. Supportive during setbacks.

### Wise Mentor
**Best for:** Those who value reflection

Thoughtful and philosophical. Offers wisdom. Encourages deeper thinking. Asks probing questions.

### Cheerful Friend
**Best for:** Those who want positivity

Upbeat and energetic. Keeps things fun. Focuses on bright sides. Uses enthusiasm.

### Calm Companion
**Best for:** Those who feel overwhelmed

Steady and peaceful. Grounding presence. Reduces anxiety. Never adds pressure.

### Accountability Partner
**Best for:** Those who need motivation

Direct about expectations. Celebrates effort. Pushes you forward. Holds you to commitments.

## How to Choose

1. Go to **Preferences > AI Settings**
2. Select your preferred style
3. Changes apply immediately

## Tips

- **Experiment** - Try different styles
- **Match your mood** - Some days need different energy
- **Consider your goals** - Weight loss might want accountability; stress management might want calm

fields.title: Why Can't I See Certain Features?
fields.summary: Features may be disabled in preferences or require specific settings to enable.
fields.content:
## Common Reasons Features Are Hidden

### Module Toggles
Features like Faith and Health are optional. Check **Preferences > Module Toggles** to enable them.

### AI Features Require Consent
AI-powered insights require:
1. AI enabled in Preferences
2. AI Data Consent given

### Personal Assistant Requires Extra Consent
The Personal Assistant needs:
1. AI Features enabled
2. AI Data Consent
3. Personal Assistant enabled
4. Personal Assistant consent

### SMS Requires Phone Verification
To use SMS notifications:
1. Enter phone number in Preferences
2. Receive and enter verification code
3. Enable SMS notifications
4. Accept SMS consent

### Faith Module Is Optional
The Faith module (prayers, scripture) must be enabled in Preferences. It's off by default for non-faith users.

### Sub-Navigation
Some features are in dropdowns:
- **Health** has sub-items (Medicine, Nutrition, Vitals, etc.)
- **Organize** has sub-items (Tasks, Projects, Events, etc.)

## Still Can't Find It?

1. Check **Preferences** for module toggles
2. Ensure you've given required consents
3. Look in sub-navigation dropdowns
4. Use the Help chat to ask the assistant

fields.title: Setting and Tracking Your Goals
fields.summary: The Goals module anchors everything—your goals tell the AI what matters most.
fields.content:
## Why Goals Matter

Goals is the **anchor** for everything in WLJ. Without it, you're just logging data. With it:
- Every task connects to a goal
- The AI detects drift from intentions
- Priorities align with what matters

## The Goals Cascade

```
Annual Direction (your "why")
    ↓
Life Goals (what you want to achieve)
    ↓
Projects (in Organize module)
    ↓
Tasks (daily actions)
```

The AI understands this hierarchy.

## Setting Annual Direction

1. **Word of the Year** - A guiding theme (e.g., "Growth", "Peace")
2. **Core Theme** - What you want to accomplish
3. **Focus Areas** - Key life domains to prioritize

## Creating Goals

1. Go to **Goals > Life Goals**
2. Click **"New Goal"**
3. Enter title and description
4. Set target date (optional)
5. Choose category:
   - Health & Wellness
   - Personal Growth
   - Relationships
   - Career
   - Financial
   - Spiritual

## How the AI Uses Goals

| What You Set | What the AI Does |
|--------------|------------------|
| Word of the Year | References in insights |
| Goals | Prioritizes related tasks |
| Change Intentions | Watches for drift |
| Focus Areas | Filters what matters |

## Tips

1. **Set Annual Direction first** - Everything flows from this
2. **Limit to 3-5 goals** - Focus beats breadth
3. **Review monthly** - Are you aligned?
4. **Connect to Organize module** - Create projects from goals
5. **Journal about goals** - Reflect on alignment
fields.keywords: goals, purpose, tracking, progress, milestones, targets, objectives, set goals, annual direction, word of year

fields.title: Tasks, Projects, and the Organize Module
fields.summary: The Organize module is where intentions become action through tasks, projects, and events.
fields.content:
## Why Use the Organize Module?

Organize is where **intentions become action**. While Goals holds your life goals, Organize holds the daily tasks that achieve them.

## The Connection to Goals

Ideal flow:
1. Set **Annual Direction** in Goals
2. Create **Life Goals** that align
3. Break goals into **Projects** in Organize
4. Break projects into **Tasks**
5. Complete tasks → Projects complete → Goals achieved

The AI sees this chain and helps you stay aligned.

## Organize Features

### Tasks
**Why:** Get things out of your head

1. Click **"New Task"**
2. Set title, description
3. Choose priority: Now, Soon, Later
4. Add due date if needed
5. Link to project (optional)

### Projects
**Why:** Organize complex work

1. Click **"New Project"**
2. Set status: Active, Paused, Completed
3. Add tasks to the project
4. Track progress as tasks complete

### Events
**Why:** Never miss important dates

- Add events with dates/times
- Get SMS reminders 30 min before
- View your week at a glance

### Additional Features
- **Inventory** - Track belongings
- **Pets** - Pet care schedules
- **Recipes** - Save favorites
- **Documents** - Store references

## The Dashboard Connection

- **Tasks Today** tile shows daily count
- Overdue tasks appear in nudges
- AI tracks productivity patterns

## Tips

1. **Daily review** - Check task list each morning
2. **Use Now/Soon/Later** - Don't over-prioritize
3. **Link to projects** - See bigger picture
4. **Enable task SMS** - Due date reminders

fields.title: Medicine Tracking and Adherence
fields.summary: Never miss a dose with scheduled reminders, one-tap logging, and SMS quick-replies.
fields.content:
## Why Track Medicine?

Medication adherence is one of the most impactful health behaviors—and hardest to maintain. WLJ helps you:

- **Never miss a dose** - Visual schedules + SMS reminders
- **Build consistency** - Track adherence rates over time
- **Catch refills early** - Alerts before you run out
- **Inform your doctor** - Accurate adherence data

## Setting Up Medicines

1. Go to **Health > Medicine**
2. Click **"Add Medicine"**
3. Enter: Name, dose, frequency
4. Set schedule: days and times
5. Set refill alert threshold

## Daily Tracking

### One-Tap Check-Off
1. Visit **Health > Medicine**
2. See today's schedule with status
3. Tap to mark: **Taken**, **Missed**, or **Skipped**

### Status Badges
- 🟢 Taken
- 🟡 Pending
- 🔴 Overdue
- ⚪ Skipped

## SMS Reminders

Enable in **Preferences > SMS**:
- Get texts at scheduled times
- Reply **D** = Done
- Reply **R** = Remind in 5 min
- Reply **N** = Skip

No app needed—just text back.

## Refill Tracking

1. Enter current quantity and pills per dose
2. System calculates days remaining
3. Alert triggers at your threshold
4. Click **"Request Refill"** when low
5. Click **"Refill Received"** when filled

## Adherence Stats

- Daily, weekly, monthly views
- Per-medicine breakdown
- Identify which meds you miss most

## Tips

1. **Enable SMS** - Harder to ignore
2. **Consistent times** - Same time daily
3. **Log immediately** - Don't wait
4. **Review weekly** - Spot patterns
fields.keywords: medicine, medication, pills, dose, adherence, refill, reminder, tracking, prescription, health

fields.title: Camera Scan: Quick AI-Powered Entry
fields.summary: Photograph food, medicine, or documents for instant data entry.
fields.content:
## Why Use Camera Scan?

Camera Scan removes friction from logging. Point and shoot instead of typing:

- **Food** - Photo → Nutrition data pre-filled
- **Medicine** - Photo → Medication added
- **Documents** - Photo → Categorized and saved

### The Time Savings

Manual food entry: 2-3 minutes
Camera scan: 10 seconds

Over a week: **30+ minutes saved** on food alone.

## How to Use

1. Click **Scan** in navigation
2. Grant camera permission
3. Point at item
4. Tap **capture**
5. Wait 2-5 seconds for AI analysis
6. Review pre-filled form
7. Save

## What AI Detects

| Item Type | What Happens |
|-----------|-------------|
| Packaged Food | Brand identified, nutrition looked up |
| Home-Cooked | Portions estimated, macros calculated |
| Nutrition Label | All data extracted |
| Medicine Bottle | Name, dose, pharmacy extracted |
| Document | Categorized, saved |

## Food Recognition

### Packaged Foods
- AI identifies brand and product
- Looks up actual nutrition facts
- Returns all macros and serving size

### Home-Cooked/Restaurant
- Estimates portion visually
- Uses databases for ingredients
- Good approximations, not exact

## Tips for Best Results

1. **Good lighting** - Natural light
2. **Clear focus** - Readable text
3. **Include labels** - Best accuracy
4. **Whole plate visible** - For portions
5. **Steady hand** - Avoid blur

## Privacy

- Images processed and deleted
- Encrypted transmission
- No sharing
- Optional—use manual entry instead
fields.keywords: camera, scan, photo, food, medicine, ai, quick entry, nutrition, recognition

fields.title: The Personal Assistant
fields.summary: Get AI-powered daily priorities, trend analysis, and proactive guidance based on all your data.
fields.content:
## Why Use the Personal Assistant?

The Personal Assistant isn't a chatbot or cheerleader—it's a **task-focused guide**. Unlike the Dashboard (which shows data), the Assistant tells you **what to do next**.

## Dashboard vs Assistant

| Dashboard | Assistant |
|-----------|----------|
| Shows data | Interprets data |
| Celebrates wins | Focuses on gaps |
| Passive | Proactive |
| General insights | Specific priorities |

## Features

### Daily Priorities
Each morning, the Assistant suggests:
1. What needs attention today
2. Ordered by importance (faith first if enabled)
3. Completable with one click

### Opening Message
Brief daily check-in based on:
- Your current state
- What matters today
- Your coaching style

### Trend Analysis
- **Weekly** - Last 7 days patterns
- **Monthly** - Bigger-picture trends
- **Drift Detection** - When actions don't match intentions

### Reflection Prompts
Personalized journaling suggestions based on:
- Recent activity
- Gaps in tracking
- Goals you've set

## Priority Ordering (Faith-First)

If Faith enabled:
1. Faith items
2. Goals items
3. Long-term goals
4. Commitments
5. Maintenance
6. Optional

## Enabling the Assistant

Requires extra consent (deeper data access):

1. **Preferences > AI Settings**
2. Enable **AI Features**
3. Enable **Personal Assistant**
4. Accept consent
5. Assistant appears in navigation

## What the Assistant Sees

- Journal entries and moods
- Health data and adherence
- Task completion
- Prayer requests (if Faith)
- Goal progress

**This is why separate consent is required.**

## Tips

1. **Check daily** - Morning priority review
2. **Complete promptly** - Mark done when finished
3. **Log consistently** - Better data = better suggestions
4. **Set clear Goals** - AI needs to know intentions

fields.title: SMS Notifications Setup
fields.summary: Get text message reminders for medicine, tasks, events, and more with quick-reply actions.
fields.content:
## Why SMS?

App notifications are easy to ignore. Texts aren't. SMS ensures you:

- **Never miss medicine** - Texts at scheduled times
- **Stay on top of tasks** - Due date reminders
- **Remember events** - 30-minute advance notice
- **Respond quickly** - Reply to log without opening app

## The Quick Reply System

When you get a reminder, reply:
- **D** (Done) - Mark complete
- **R** (Remind) - 5 min later
- **N** (No/Skip) - Skip this one

No app needed. Just text back.

## Setting Up SMS

### Step 1: Add Phone
1. **Preferences > SMS Notifications**
2. Enter phone number
3. Click **"Send Verification Code"**
4. Enter 6-digit code

### Step 2: Enable SMS
1. Toggle **"Enable SMS Notifications"**
2. Accept SMS consent

### Step 3: Choose Categories
- ✅ Medicine reminders
- ✅ Medicine refill alerts
- ✅ Task due dates
- ✅ Event reminders
- ✅ Prayer reminders
- ✅ Fasting reminders

### Step 4: Quiet Hours
No texts during sleep:
- Set start (e.g., 10:00 PM)
- Set end (e.g., 7:00 AM)
- Reminders queue until end

## Notification Types

| Type | When | Example |
|------|------|----------|
| Medicine | Scheduled time | "Time for Metformin. Reply D/R/N" |
| Refill | Supply low | "3 days left: Metformin" |
| Task | Due date | "Due today: Buy groceries" |
| Event | 30 min before | "In 30 min: Doctor" |
| Prayer | Morning | "Prayer reminder" |
| Fasting | Window times | "Eating window opens at noon" |

## Tips

1. **Start with medicine** - Most impactful
2. **Set quiet hours** - Respect sleep
3. **Use reply codes** - Faster than app
4. **Check SMS history** - View sent messages in app
fields.keywords: sms, text, notifications, reminders, medicine, phone, verify, twilio, messages

fields.title: Nutrition and Food Tracking
fields.summary: Track what you eat to understand patterns and hit your calorie and macro goals.
fields.content:
## Why Track Nutrition?

You can't manage what you don't measure. Nutrition tracking helps you:

- **Understand patterns** - When do you overeat?
- **Hit goals** - See exact calorie/macro progress
- **Identify triggers** - Connect eating to mood/stress
- **Make informed choices** - Know impact before eating

## The Dashboard Connection

Your nutrition data powers:
- **Today's Nutrition** summary with progress bars
- AI insights about eating patterns
- Personal Assistant nudges when off-target
- Weekly trend analysis

## How to Log Food

### Method 1: Camera Scan (Fastest)
1. Click **Scan**
2. Point at food or label
3. AI identifies and estimates
4. Save pre-filled entry

### Method 2: Quick Add
1. **Nutrition > Quick Add**
2. Enter name and basics
3. Save quickly

### Method 3: Full Entry
1. **Add Food Entry**
2. All nutritional details
3. Meal type, location, pace
4. Hunger/fullness levels

## Tracking Details

- **Meal Types:** Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Snack
- **Location:** Home, Restaurant, Work, Travel
- **Eating Pace:** Rushed, Normal, Slow/Mindful
- **Hunger/Fullness:** 1-5 scale

## Setting Goals

In **Preferences > Weight & Nutrition Goals**:

1. Daily Calorie Goal
2. Macro Split (Protein/Carbs/Fat %)
3. Presets: Balanced, High Protein, Low Carb, Keto

Dashboard shows progress bars once set.

## Tips

1. **Log before eating** - Easier to remember
2. **Use Camera Scan** - AI does the work
3. **Don't aim for perfection** - Estimates beat nothing
4. **Review weekly** - Daily variation is normal
5. **Create custom foods** - For common meals

fields.title: Getting Started with Cycle Tracking
fields.summary: Track your menstrual cycle, log symptoms and mood, and get predictions for upcoming periods.
fields.content:
## What is Cycle Tracking?

Cycle tracking helps you understand your body's natural rhythms. By logging a few details each day, you can:

- **Know when to expect your period** - Based on your personal patterns
- **Track how you feel** - Notice connections between your cycle and mood
- **Spot patterns** - Understand what's normal for you
- **Be prepared** - Get gentle reminders before your period arrives

## Getting Started

### Step 1: Enable Cycle Tracking

1. Go to **Health > Cycle**
2. Read the privacy information
3. Click **"Enable Cycle Tracking"**

You're in control—you can disable it anytime and even delete all your data.

### Step 2: Set Your Preferences

After enabling, you'll set up some basics:

- **Average cycle length** - How many days between periods (most people: 25-35 days)
- **Average period length** - How many days your period typically lasts
- **Notifications** - Optional reminders for predictions
- **Fertile window tracking** - Optional if you want to track this

Don't worry if you're not sure—these can be adjusted later, and the app learns from your actual data.

### Step 3: Log Your First Entry

1. Visit **Health > Cycle** (your dashboard)
2. Click on today's date
3. Select your **flow level** (or "none" if not on your period)
4. Add any **symptoms** you're experiencing
5. Note your **mood** and **energy**
6. Save!

That's it. Even logging just flow level is helpful.

## What to Track

### Flow Level
How heavy is your period today?
- **None** - Not on your period
- **Spotting** - Very light, occasional
- **Light** - Light bleeding
- **Medium** - Normal flow
- **Heavy** - Heavier than usual

### Symptoms (Optional)
Common things to track:
- Cramps
- Headache
- Fatigue
- Bloating
- Breast tenderness
- Backache
- Food cravings
- And more...

### Mood & Energy (Optional)
How are you feeling emotionally? How's your energy? These help you see patterns.

## Using the Calendar

The **Calendar** view shows your history at a glance:
- **Red dots** - Period days
- **Pink dots** - Spotting
- **Green highlight** - Predicted fertile window (if enabled)
- **Striped days** - Predicted period

Click any day to see details or add a log.

## Tips for Success

1. **Log daily during your period** - Even a quick flow level helps
2. **Don't stress about gaps** - Some data is better than none
3. **Be patient with predictions** - They improve after 3+ cycles
4. **Check the calendar** - See your patterns over time

## Your Privacy Matters

This is sensitive, personal information. Here's how we protect it:
- **Opt-in only** - You choose to enable it
- **Your data, your choice** - Export or delete anytime
- **No sharing** - Your cycle data stays private
- **Encrypted** - Protected in storage and transit

fields.title: Cycle Tracking FAQ
fields.summary: Answers to common questions about cycle tracking, predictions, and privacy.
fields.content:
## Frequently Asked Questions

### Getting Started

**Q: How do I enable cycle tracking?**

Go to **Health > Cycle** and click "Enable Cycle Tracking." You'll see privacy information first, then can set your preferences.

**Q: What if I don't know my average cycle length?**

That's okay! Start with 28 days (the average). The app will learn your actual pattern as you log. You can always update it later in Settings.

**Q: Do I need to log every single day?**

No. Log when you can, especially during your period. Even partial data helps. The more you log, the better the predictions—but don't stress about gaps.

### Using the Features

**Q: What's the difference between the Dashboard and Calendar?**

The **Dashboard** shows today's status and quick actions. The **Calendar** shows your full history with color-coded days. Both let you log entries.

**Q: What do the different colors mean on the calendar?**

- Red = Period days (confirmed by you)
- Pink = Spotting
- Striped = Predicted period
- Green = Predicted fertile window (if enabled)
- Today = Highlighted border

**Q: How do I log for a past day?**

Click on that day in the Calendar, or use the date picker when creating a new log. You can log for any date.

### About Predictions

**Q: Why don't I see period predictions?**

Predictions need at least 3 recorded cycles to generate. Keep logging, and predictions will appear once there's enough data.

**Q: How accurate are the predictions?**

Predictions are based on YOUR patterns and improve over time. Most users find them accurate within 1-3 days after several cycles. Remember—bodies aren't perfectly regular, so predictions are estimates.

**Q: Can I trust the predictions for planning?**

They're helpful for general planning, but cycles can vary. Use them as a guide, not a guarantee. The confidence percentage shows how reliable each prediction is.

### Symptoms & Patterns

**Q: Why track symptoms?**

Tracking symptoms helps you notice patterns. You might discover you always get headaches before your period, or that fatigue is common during certain phases. This awareness can help you prepare.

**Q: What are the cycle phases?**

- **Menstrual** (Period) - When you're bleeding
- **Follicular** - After period, before ovulation
- **Ovulation** - Most fertile time
- **Luteal** - After ovulation, before next period

The app shows which phase you're in based on your cycle day.

### Privacy & Data

**Q: Who can see my cycle data?**

Only you. Cycle data is private to your account and isn't shared with anyone—not even aggregated for statistics.

**Q: Can I delete my cycle data?**

Yes, completely. Go to **Health > Cycle > Data Management** and choose "Delete All Data." This permanently removes everything.

**Q: What happens if I disable cycle tracking?**

You have two options:
1. **Disable and keep data** - Data is preserved but hidden
2. **Disable and delete** - Everything is permanently removed

**Q: Can I export my data?**

Yes! Export as JSON (complete backup) or CSV (spreadsheet-friendly). Go to **Health > Cycle > Data Management**.

fields.content:
## Your Privacy Comes First

We understand that cycle data is deeply personal. That's why we've built privacy into every aspect of this feature.

## Our Privacy Principles

### 1. Opt-In Only

Cycle tracking is **never enabled automatically**. You explicitly choose to turn it on, and you're shown clear information about what you're enabling.

### 2. Your Data Stays Yours

- Your cycle data is **never shared** with anyone
- It's **not used** for advertising or sold to third parties
- It's **not aggregated** into statistics (even anonymously)
- Only **you** can see it

### 3. You Control Everything

At any time, you can:
- **Disable** cycle tracking
- **Export** all your data
- **Delete** everything permanently

## How Your Data is Protected

### Encryption
- Data is encrypted during transmission (HTTPS)
- Data is encrypted at rest in our database
- We follow industry security standards

### Access Controls
- Only you can access your cycle data
- Even our support team cannot view it
- No third-party services receive this data

## Exporting Your Data

You can download a complete copy of your cycle data anytime.

### How to Export

1. Go to **Health > Cycle > Data Management**
2. Choose your format:
   - **JSON** - Complete backup, includes everything
   - **CSV** - Spreadsheet format, easy to view in Excel
3. Click Export
4. Your file downloads immediately

### What's Included

- All daily logs with symptoms, mood, notes
- All cycle records with dates and lengths
- All predictions with confidence levels
- Your settings and preferences

## Deleting Your Data

You can permanently delete all cycle data at any time.

### How to Delete

1. Go to **Health > Cycle > Data Management**
2. Click **"Delete All Cycle Data"**
3. Type the confirmation phrase
4. Click Delete

### What Happens

- All daily logs are permanently deleted
- All cycle records are removed
- All predictions are erased
- Your settings are cleared
- This **cannot be undone**

### Alternative: Disable Without Deleting

If you want to pause tracking but keep your data, you can disable cycle tracking in Settings. Your data remains but is hidden until you re-enable.

## Questions About Privacy?

If you have concerns about your data, we're here to help. Your trust matters to us, and we're committed to protecting your most personal information.

fields.title: Understanding Cycle Predictions
fields.summary: How period predictions work, what affects accuracy, and what the confidence levels mean.
fields.content:
## How Predictions Work

Cycle predictions are based on **your personal patterns**, not generic averages. The more you log, the better they get.

## The Basic Idea

Your body has patterns. By tracking when your periods start and end, the app learns:

- Your typical cycle length (days between periods)
- Your typical period length (days of bleeding)
- How regular or irregular your cycles are

With this information, it can estimate when your next period will likely arrive.

## What You Need for Predictions

### Minimum: 3 Cycles

Predictions need at least **3 recorded cycles** to generate. This gives enough data to identify your pattern.

### Better: 6+ Cycles

With more data, predictions become more accurate and confidence levels increase.

## Understanding Confidence Levels

Each prediction includes a **confidence percentage** that tells you how reliable it is.

### What Affects Confidence

- **More cycles recorded** → Higher confidence
- **Regular cycles** → Higher confidence
- **Irregular cycles** → Lower confidence
- **Recent changes** → Temporarily lower confidence

### Confidence Guide

| Confidence | What It Means |
|------------|---------------|
| 80-100% | Very reliable prediction |
| 60-79% | Good prediction, minor variation possible |
| 40-59% | Estimate only, your cycles may vary |
| Below 40% | Just a rough guide |

## Why Predictions Might Be Off

### Normal Variation

Bodies aren't clockwork. Even with regular cycles, variation of 1-3 days is completely normal.

### Life Changes

Many things can affect your cycle:
- Stress
- Travel or time zone changes
- Illness
- Changes in exercise or diet
- Medications
- Major life events

### Not Enough Data

If you've only logged a few cycles, predictions will improve as you continue tracking.

## Improving Your Predictions

1. **Log consistently** - Mark when your period starts and ends
2. **Update your flow level** - Helps detect period boundaries
3. **Give it time** - Accuracy improves with each cycle
4. **Update settings** - If your cycle length changes significantly

## What Predictions Show

### Period Prediction
- Expected start date
- Expected end date (based on your average)
- Days until period

### Fertile Window (If Enabled)
- Estimated fertile days
- Based on typical ovulation timing

**Note:** Fertile window predictions are estimates only and should not be relied upon for family planning.

## A Helpful Tool, Not a Guarantee

Predictions are meant to help you prepare—not to be perfectly precise. Use them for general planning, but remember that your body may not follow the exact schedule.

fields.title: Capture: Voice Recording & Transcription
fields.summary: Record voice memos and have them automatically transcribed, summarized, and saved for reference.
fields.content:
## What is Capture?

Capture lets you speak your thoughts instead of typing them. Record a voice memo, and WLJ will:

1. **Transcribe** it to text automatically
2. **Summarize** the key points
3. **Save** it for future reference
4. **Expire** after 30 days (to keep storage manageable)

## Why Use Voice?

- **Faster than typing** - Speak 150 words/minute vs. type 40
- **Capture in the moment** - While driving, walking, or multitasking
- **More natural** - Some thoughts flow better when spoken
- **Lower friction** - No keyboard needed

## How to Record

### Method 1: In-App Recording
1. Click **Capture** in navigation
2. Click **Record Audio**
3. Grant microphone permission (first time)
4. Speak your memo
5. Click **Stop** when finished
6. Add a title (optional)
7. Wait for transcription (usually 10-30 seconds)

### Method 2: Upload Audio File
1. Click **Capture > Upload**
2. Select an audio file (MP3, WAV, M4A, etc.)
3. Processing happens automatically

## What Happens After Recording

1. **Upload** - Audio securely uploaded
2. **Transcription** - AI converts speech to text
3. **Summarization** - Key points extracted
4. **Save** - Entry appears in your Capture list

Processing typically takes 10-60 seconds depending on length.

## Managing Your Captures

### View Captures
- Go to **Capture** to see all recordings
- Click any entry to see full transcription
- Search by keyword or date

### Edit Titles
Click the title to rename for easier finding later.

### Categories
Organize captures into categories for filtering.

### Delete
Remove captures you no longer need.

## Auto-Expiration

**By default, captures expire after 30 days.** This keeps your storage manageable and encourages timely review.

- You'll receive a reminder email before expiration
- Important captures can be saved permanently
- Expired content is deleted automatically

## SMS Notifications

Enable notifications to receive:
- Processing complete alerts
- Expiration reminders
- Failed processing alerts

## Tips for Better Transcriptions

1. **Speak clearly** - Natural pace, enunciate
2. **Quiet environment** - Reduces background noise errors
3. **State context** - "This is about my meeting with John..."
4. **Keep under 10 minutes** - Shorter = faster processing
5. **Review and edit** - AI isn't perfect

## Use Cases

- **Daily reflections** - Speak instead of journaling
- **Meeting notes** - Capture key points
- **Ideas** - Record thoughts before they escape
- **To-do lists** - Speak tasks to transcribe
- **Voice memos** - General note-taking

See upcoming transactions and never miss a bill.

Set savings targets with deadlines:

- Major purchases

Track progress with visual indicators.

fields.content:
## Natural Language Data Search

One of the most powerful features of the AI Assistant is searching your own data using plain English. No filters to configure—just ask.

## What You Can Search

### Journal Entries
- "Show me journal entries about anxiety"
- "When did I write about my promotion?"
- "Find entries where I mentioned my mom"
- "What did I journal about last week?"

### Health Data
- "What was my weight on January 15th?"
- "Show my blood pressure readings from last month"
- "Did I take my medicine yesterday?"
- "How many workouts did I do this week?"

### Tasks & Projects
- "What tasks are due this week?"
- "Show me completed tasks from last month"
- "What projects am I working on?"
- "List my overdue tasks"

### Goals & Progress
- "What are my active goals?"
- "Am I on track with my annual direction?"
- "Show my goal progress"

### Faith (if enabled)
- "What prayers have been answered?"
- "Show my active prayer requests"
- "When did I pray about my job?"

### Nutrition & Food
- "What did I eat yesterday?"
- "How many calories have I had today?"
- "Show my nutrition for last week"

## How It Works

1. **You ask** in natural language
2. **AI interprets** your intent
3. **AI searches** the relevant data type
4. **Results displayed** with context

## Tips for Effective Searches

### Be Specific About Time
- ✅ "Last week" / "January 2026" / "Yesterday"
- ❌ "Recently" (too vague)

### Name the Data Type
- ✅ "Journal entries about..." / "Weight readings from..."
- ❌ "Show me stuff about..." (unclear)

### Use Keywords from Your Entries
The AI searches your actual text. Use words you'd have used when logging.

### Ask Follow-Up Questions
After seeing results, drill deeper:
- "Tell me more about that entry"
- "What was my mood that day?"
- "Show similar entries"

## Privacy & Security

- Searches only your own data
- Results never shared externally
- AI processing is secure
- You control what the AI can access via consent settings

## When Search Works Best

- **Consistent logging** - More data = better results
- **Descriptive entries** - Detail helps matching
- **Regular use** - AI learns your patterns
